/etc/sysctl.d/90-proxcloud-lb.conf
net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 2
net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter = 2
/etc/systemd/system/keepalived.service.d/proxcloud.conf
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/ip link set dev ens19 up
/usr/local/sbin/proxcloud-lb-check
#!/bin/sh
worker() ( out=$(echo 'show proc' | socat -t1 - UNIX-CONNECT:/run/haproxy-master.sock 2>/dev/null) && echo "$out" | grep -qw worker )
n=0
until worker; do
  n=$((n+1))
  [ $n -lt 4 ] || exit 1
  sleep 0.2
done
[ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg 2>/dev/null || echo 0) )) -ge 10 ] || exit 0
b=$(awk '$1=="bind" && $2 !~ /^unix@/{print $2; exit}' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$b" ] || exit 0
case "$b" in :*) b="0.0.0.0$b" ;; esac
ss -Hltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -qxF -e "$b"
/usr/local/sbin/proxcloud-lb-notify
#!/bin/sh
echo "$3" > /run/proxcloud-lb.state.$$ && mv -f /run/proxcloud-lb.state.$$ /run/proxcloud-lb.state
